document-writer.description: Create/edit formal product, technical and management documents; review expression, structure, consistency and audience fit; exclude internal agent plans/state.
document-writer.orchestratorPrompt:
- Use document-writer with MODE: WRITE for formal document creation/body edits, or MODE: REVIEW for expression, structure, document-internal consistency, audience fit and readability.
- Keep internal agent plans/state in the main session and independent platform work with lark-operator. Apply the main-session document/review policy for dispatch and acceptance.

lark-operator.description: Handle independent Lark reads and platform operations, excluding formal document writing and local file maintenance.
lark-operator.orchestratorPrompt: Use lark-operator for independent Lark reads/actions; never run platform skills directly. Route local Lark skill files, including lark-skill-maker work, to fixer; operator supplies platform facts and authorized validation only.
